profile.headline: Staff Engineer at Vantaca
profile.summary: I am a loving husband, father, passionate software engineer, and die hard Patriots fan. Just like the Pats, I love learning new ways to win and perfect my craft. I'm constantly seeking ways to learn and grow my skill sets. I love learning about new technologies, most recently Microsoft's server-side .NET Core framework, their introduction to the open source world. On the front end I love Angular 2/4 and Typescript as it promotes great design patterns off the bat such as Dependency injection, modularization, and Bootstrapping. I call it Javascript for .NET developers. I've been developing and deploying production-ready software for over 7 years.  I'm interested in perfecting my code through good software design practices, efficient memory management and the application of clean code. Love bouncing ideas and talking about new technologies so feel free to drop me a message.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Onboard, mentor and support development team and interns. 
- Contribute to product requirements gathering and roadmap planning. 
- Maintain HA VMWare servers at local datacenter for all hosted appplications. 
- Maintain and configure Zabbix system monitoring tool for system failure detection and recovery.
- Maintain and support legacy SQL Server database DML and DDL used for data analytics. 
- Maintain and support legacy Windows ETL process designed to transmit Point of Sale data to Host servers for data processing and analytics. 
- Maintain and support legacy PHP services that process new data payloads from client ETL machines. 
- Implemented Scrum methodology, technical documentation and task automation with JIRA & Confluence. 
- Implemented Source Control and a Continuous Integration pipeline with Bamboo, Jenkins and Docker. 
- Co-architected and developed an ASP.NET Web application to automate the provisioning process of new clients and client ETL servers, significantly reducing client sign up time by 90%. 
- Architected and developed an OAuth2.0 and OpenID Authorization Server with asp.net core for unified platform authentication of client applications and users. 
- Architected and developed asp.net core microservices with token authentication for platform data services. 
- Designed and developed an Angular 2 analytics dashboard for global beauty manufacturer to report sales and product data for all network affiliated beauty salons. Developed a dedicated mobile view for real-time reporting of salon POS data. 
- Contributed to design of new event-driven data pipeline architecture using Kafka message queue and Spark streaming for POS data processing. 
- Architected and developed management tool to automate the definition and formula of KPIs to be processed by Spark. 
- Developed Scala application to dynamically calculate KPIs based off their user generated formulas. 
- Developed Unit Testing suite for platform data services test automation.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager, Custom Integrations Team
positions.description:
- Managed global team of software engineers specializing in call center software integrations.
- Responsible for designing, documenting and allocating tasks for new professional services software integrations.
- Responsible for SDK developer training and materials. Served as first point of contact for SDK support and feature requests. 
- Implemented TFS source control for all software integration projects.
- Implemented automated task management and software documentation with JIRA & Confluence.
- Designed and developed a Windows Desktop application to automate task management for call center agent's after-call work for public transportation system of Madrid, Spain. 
- Designed and developed long running ETL process to curate new outbound call leads for largest outbound call center in Mexico. 
- Designed and developed a custom web application for a leading Colombian contact center to automate list filtering for outbound calls. Reduced outbound call list preparation time by 75%. 
- Designed and developed a Salesforce One plugin prototype for a WebRTC Softphone integration with Presence Technology's CTI software.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Mobile Web Services Team
positions.description:
- Collaborated with mobile web services scrum team to develop, maintain, and deploy Fiserv's financial services platform api, processing over 1M daily transactions. 
- Developed and maintained platform features such as ACH, wire transfer, and peer-to-peer transfers consumed by mobile bank applications using .NET's WCF framework
- Developed and maintained automated testing suites using NUnit and Moq to achieve 85% code coverage of all platform services. 
- Participated in release management planning and deployment support for platform services. 
- Participated in Epic and Story planning for bi-weekly Agile sprints

positions.title: Software Engineer/Technical Consultant
positions.description:
- Serve as trusted technology advisor to clients by promoting and implementing enterprise-ready .NET technology solutions. 
- Gathered requirements, designed, and developed custom .NET applications guided by expert senior engineers. 
- Successfully developed and completed an enterprise ASP.NET CMS website for a local IT firm to monitor network devices and create automated tickets through Web API calls.This included an integration with Google Geolocation and Map APIs to display aggregated network device detail by monitored location. Developed and deployed 10 custom CMS modules and 3 scheduled running tasks to integrate data between two disparate monitoring systems. Developed a custom report creator using Telerik Reporting Framework and Telerik Report Designer to report on historical monitoring data.
- Served as a CRM consultant for local fashion firm, Spanx, Inc. Helped redesign and build a product questionnaire page on the corporate site using ASP.NET Web forms (C#). Developed an integration that linked an online profile user with a master Microsoft CRM record. 
- Design and developed a registration form for the Georgia Lottery using ASP.NET Web Forms (VB.NET) to process the application of gaming machines for commercial businesses.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, coded, and tested the integration of hardware devices, web services, and database synchronization for a self-checkout kiosk POS solution.
- Worked closely with software architects to design scalable software modules. 
- Learned design patterns to facilitate automated testing including dependency injection and inversion of control. 
- Developed automated test suites for each software module using NUnit and Moq for hardware device simulation, dramatically reducing unexpected device malfunction scenarios. 
- Designed and developed a Windows service to transfer and receive data over Bluetooth 2.0 between a handheld Windows Mobile device and a Windows machine which served for authenticating a kiosk service technician. 
- Designed and developed a long running service to synchronize a local kiosk database and the server database using Microsoft Sync Framework. Included in this synchronization process was a WCF Web service to listen for incoming synchronization requests and transfer back changed data.

positions.title: Product Support Engineer
positions.description:
- Interacted with Agile Teams and Network Operations to reproduce and resolve automated email marketing product issues. 
- Worked closely with QA and development to reproduce and test product defect. 
- Identified and documented production defects caused by stored procedures, server side code (Java), system deployment/maintenance downtime, API, third party integrations, or client JavaScript code. 
- Developed custom tools to aid in automating complex test scenarios. Tools developed included a PHP script for executing SMTP mailings, a Web app tool composed of JavaScript, PHP, and XML API for creating and updating marketing lists that integrate with salesforce.com, and several custom stored procedures for aiding in identifying client data issues. 
- Worked in conjunction with the Salesforce integrations team to identify and correct data synchronization issues, xml batch processing failures, and performance issues caused by high volume transactions. Became very familiar with Salesforce Cloud using Salesforce.com's sandbox environment to replicate failed synchronization jobs between Silverpop’s mailing list database and salesforce.com CRM database.

projects.title: ZeeZor Kiosk Project
projects.description: ZeeZor Kiosk Project is a development team. Member since February 2013. Currently owns 1 public repository. This is an open source project to develop a self checkout kiosk for the vending industry. This is a private source repository but limited access is available to those interested in viewing my code samples.
